review:
Mustang Gold is a Wild West money-collect slot with a 12,000x maximum win. Money symbols on reels one to four carry 1x–35x, and a collect symbol landing on reel five at the same time pays all of them.

Collecting a money symbol with the jackpot value starts the Jackpot Reveal, where matching three symbols wins a 50x, 100x, 200x or 1,000x jackpot. Three scatters award eight free spins with more money and collect symbols, retriggered endlessly by three more scatters. Pragmatic lists a 96.53% RTP. It suits players who like straightforward collect games with jackpots.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
cons: Pragmatic Play doesn't publish a volatility rating for this game
Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
